newsitem.title: FRANCE: Paribas industrial profits seen at over 2 bln frf.
newsitem.headline: Paribas industrial profits seen at over 2 bln frf.

text.p: The profits of Paribas industrial affairs unit -- which hold stakes in various companies -- should in 1997 be more than two billion francs, Paribas chairman Andre-Levy Lang.
"The profit contribution to the group of Paribas Affaires industrielles in 1997 should, without accidents, be higher than two billion francs," he told the general meeting of shareholders.
He added that the portfolio of industrial and financial assets of the group represented unrealised asset gains of 15 billion francs when sold today, against 12.6 billion at the start of the year.
This is 138 francs per Paribas share, he said.
